title: Near-Optimal Learning of Local Lindbladians
authors: Itai Arad, Zhili Chen, **Naixu Guo**, Patrick Rebentrost, Zhan Yu (alphabetical order)
venue: ACM-SIAM Symposium on Discrete Algorithms (SODA 2027), accepted
summary: A near-optimal protocol for learning local Lindbladians from finite-time channel probes, with matching lower bounds on channel uses and total evolution time.

sources.note: SODA 2027 acceptance confirmed by the author.
